integrity: Exact exhaustive enumerations by two graph constructions, agreement of three autocorrelation computations and two embedded CSV tables; no assertion of external or independent scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: Complete finite result only for binary de Bruijn cycles of order five. All historical priority statements are conditional on inspected literature; the 1982 SIAM full paper was inaccessible. No proof of an all-order classification or uniqueness outside this family.
title: Almost-complete cyclic phase retrieval for binary order-five de Bruijn cycles
